home.capabilitiesSubtitle: Comprehensive architectural craftsmanship under one roof. We blend industrial steel strength with fine timber aesthetics.
home.workflowSubtitle: Every project follows our rigorous 4-step engineering and craftsmanship workflow.
home.step1Desc: Detailed site measurements, architectural blueprints, and material selection.
home.step2Desc: Accurate breakdown of raw steel, hardwood lumber, fabrication labor, and installation.
home.step3Desc: Computerized cutting, TIG/MIG welding, joinery, and anti-corrosion finishing.
home.step4Desc: Direct transport from Bole Arabsa workshop and professional installation.

about.title: HARA WORKSHOP
about.subtitle: Metal and Wood Solution • Bole Arabsa, Addis Ababa
about.desc: Founded with a steadfast commitment to structural durability, refined aesthetics, and Ethiopian craftsmanship. We engineer architectural steel structures and handcraft bespoke solid wood furniture for residences, commercial enterprises, and institutions.
about.philosophyDesc: No shortcuts on gauge, joints, or finish. We select high-grade structural steel and seasoned local and imported hardwoods to ensure our work lasts generations.
about.expertDesc: Our team comprises certified welders, veteran carpenters, architectural draftsmen, and finishing specialists working collaboratively in our Bole Arabsa workshop.
about.qualityDesc: Every order progresses through strict quality checkpoints—from raw material inspection and laser cutting to final coat curing and site installation.
about.visitDesc: We welcome clients, architects, and interior designers to visit our active workshop floor. Review material samples, examine weld beads, and discuss custom designs directly with our fabricators.
about.modalDesc: To schedule a workshop consultation or request a custom quotation, please sign in or register your customer account first.
